shippingPolicy.title: Shipping & Delivery Policy
shippingPolicy.intro: At  GEYE INNOVATION FOUNDATION (doing business as GREENEYE®), we are committed to delivering your products in a timely, safe, and efficient manner. Please read the following shipping and delivery terms carefully before placing your order.
shippingPolicy.domesticText: For domestic buyers, all orders are shipped through registered Indian courier companies and/or Speed Post services only. We currently do not ship products outside of India.
shippingPolicy.processingText: Orders are usually processed and dispatched within 5-7 working days from the date of order confirmation and successful payment, or as per the delivery date agreed at the time of order confirmation. Processing and delivery are subject to the policies and timelines of our courier partners.
shippingPolicy.liabilityText: GEYE INNOVATION FOUNDATION is not responsible for delays caused by courier companies, postal authorities, or unforeseen events. Our responsibility is limited to handing over the consignment to the courier company within the promised time frame. All deliveries will be made to the registered address provided at checkout. We are not liable for any damage to the products while in transit.
shippingPolicy.paymentsText: We are proud to use secure payment gateways such as Razorpay for fast, reliable, and safe transactions. All major credit cards, debit cards, UPI, and net banking options are accepted. Your financial details are never shared with us and remain encrypted at all times.
shippingPolicy.servicesText: For services purchased on our website, confirmation details will be sent to your registered email ID at the time of order. If you face any issues while using our services, please reach out to our helpdesk at contact@greeneye.foundation.
shippingPolicy.chargesText: For Indian customers, a standard shipping charge of ₹79 applies to all product orders. If multiple items are ordered to a single address, the system calculates total weight and applies one delivery fee. However, if different products are ordered for delivery to different locations, delivery charges are applied separately as per each shipping address.
shippingPolicy.disclaimerText: Products will be delivered to all serviceable urban areas in India through leading courier agencies. For remote or rural areas, delivery may be routed through local couriers or India Speed Post and could take additional time. Please note that certain products may be subject to area-specific delivery restrictions.
shippingPolicy.contactText: For shipping-related queries, please write to us at: contact@greeneye.foundation or call 📞 +91 92264-92263

cancellationsRefunds.title: Cancellations & Refunds Policy
cancellationsRefunds.intro: At GEYE INNOVATION FOUNDATION (doing business as GREENEYE®), we value your trust and want to make sure your experience with us is smooth, transparent, and fair. Please read our detailed cancellations and refunds policy carefully before making a purchase.
cancellationsRefunds.cancellationText: Orders may be cancelled within 24 hours of placing them, provided they have not yet been processed or shipped. Once the order has been dispatched, we regret that cancellations cannot be accepted. To request a cancellation, please contact us immediately with your order details.
cancellationsRefunds.refundText: Refunds are initiated only after the returned product has been inspected and approved by our quality team. Once approved, refunds will be processed within 7-10 business days and credited back to the original method of payment. Please note that shipping charges are non-refundable.
cancellationsRefunds.exceptionsText: Certain items are not eligible for cancellation or refund. These include: perishable goods (such as plants), customized or personalized products, digital services, and items marked as 'Final Sale'.
cancellationsRefunds.disclaimerText: GEYE INNOVATION FOUNDATION is not responsible for delays caused by courier companies or unforeseen events. Refunds or cancellations due to such delays will not be entertained unless explicitly agreed upon.
cancellationsRefunds.contactText: For cancellation and refund-related queries, please reach out to us at: contact@greeneye.foundation. Our support team will be happy to assist you.
